author: 박지호
title: Attention, Learn to Solve Routing Problems!
authors: Wouter Kool; Herke van Hoof; Max Welling
abstract: The recently presented idea to learn heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems is promising as it can save costly development. However, to push this idea towards practical implementation, we need better models and better ways of training. We contribute in both directions: we propose a model based on attention layers with benefits over the Pointer Network and we show how to train this model using REINFORCE with a simple baseline based on a deterministic greedy rollout, which we find is more efficient than using a value function. We significantly improve over recent learned heuristics for the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP), getting close to optimal results for problems up to 100 nodes. With the same hyperparameters, we learn strong heuristics for two variants of the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP), the Orienteering Problem (OP) and (a stochastic variant of) the Prize Collecting TSP (PCTSP), outperforming a wide range of baselines and getting results close to highly optimized and specialized algorithms.
content: Routing problem을 푸는 learned heuristic을 실용 단계로 끌어올리기 위해 더 나은 모델과 더 나은 학습 방법을 함께 제안한 논문이다. 모델은 기존 Pointer Network 대신 attention layer를 기반으로 구성하였고, 학습은 value function 대신 deterministic greedy rollout을 baseline으로 사용하는 REINFORCE로 진행하였다. 저자들은 이 baseline이 value function을 쓰는 것보다 효율적이라고 주장한다. TSP에서는 최대 100 node 문제까지 기존 learned heuristic을 크게 앞서며 최적해에 가까운 결과를 얻었고, 같은 hyperparameter로 VRP의 두 가지 변형, Orienteering Problem, (stochastic variant of) Prize Collecting TSP까지 학습하여 여러 baseline보다 좋은 성능을 보였다. 문제마다 모델을 새로 설계하지 않고 하나의 틀로 여러 routing 문제를 푼다는 점이 contribution이다.
memo: 학습 기반 routing 논문을 볼 때 기준점이 되는 논문이라 먼저 읽었다. 다만 100 node 수준이면 실제 last-mile 배송 규모(수백~수천 고객)와는 거리가 있다. 시간창이나 heterogeneous fleet 같은 제약이 붙으면 같은 구조가 그대로 통할지 궁금하다…

author: 박지호
title: Optimization Approaches for the Traveling Salesman Problem with Drone
authors: Niels Agatz; Paul Bouman; Marie Schmidt
abstract: The fast and cost-efficient home delivery of goods ordered online is logistically challenging. Many companies are looking for new ways to cross the last mile to their customers. One technology-enabled opportunity that recently has received much attention is the use of drones to support deliveries. An innovative last-mile delivery concept in which a truck collaborates with a drone to make deliveries gives rise to a new variant of the traveling salesman problem (TSP) that we call the TSP with drone. In this paper, we model this problem as an integer program and develop several fast route-first, cluster-second heuristics based on local search and dynamic programming. We prove worst-case approximation ratios for the heuristics and test their performance by comparing the solutions to the optimal solutions for small instances. In addition, we apply our heuristics to several artificial instances with different characteristics and sizes. Our experiments show that substantial savings are possible with this concept compared to truck-only delivery.
content: Truck과 drone이 협업하여 배송하는 last-mile delivery 개념을 TSP with drone(TSP-D)이라는 새로운 TSP 변형으로 정의하고 이를 푸는 방법을 제안한 논문이다. 먼저 문제를 integer program으로 모델링하였고, local search와 dynamic programming에 기반한 route-first, cluster-second 방식의 빠른 heuristic 여러 개를 개발하였다. 각 heuristic에 대해 worst-case approximation ratio를 증명하였으며, 작은 instance에서는 최적해와 비교하고 크기와 특성이 다른 artificial instance에도 적용하여 성능을 확인하였다. 실험 결과 truck-only 배송에 비해 이 concept으로 상당한 절감이 가능함을 보였다.
memo: Truck과 drone 한 대가 협업하는 설정이라 이후 truck-and-drone 논문들의 출발점으로 보인다. 최적해 비교는 small instance에 한정되고 나머지는 artificial instance라, 실제 도시 도로망과 고객 분포에서도 같은 절감이 나오는지는 의문이다. drone 배터리와 payload 제약이 어떻게 들어가는지도 확인이 필요하다…

author: 박지호
title: Crowdsourced Delivery—A Dynamic Pickup and Delivery Problem with Ad Hoc Drivers
authors: Alp M. Arslan; Niels Agatz; Leo Kroon; Rob Zuidwijk
abstract: The trend toward shorter delivery lead times reduces operational efficiency and increases transportation costs for Internet retailers. However, mobile technology creates new opportunities to organize the last mile. In this paper, we study the concept of crowdsourced delivery that aims to use excess capacity on journeys that already take place. We consider a service platform that automatically creates matches between parcel delivery tasks and ad hoc drivers. The platform also operates a fleet of dedicated vehicles to serve the tasks that cannot be served by the ad hoc drivers. The matching of tasks, drivers, and dedicated vehicles in real time gives rise to a new variant of the dynamic pickup and delivery problem. We propose a rolling horizon framework and develop an exact solution approach to solve the matching problem each time new information becomes available. To investigate the potential benefit of crowdsourced delivery, we conduct a wide range of computational experiments. The experiments provide insights into the viability of crowdsourced delivery under various assumptions about the behavior of the ad hoc drivers. The results suggest that the use of ad hoc drivers has the potential to make the last mile more cost-efficient and can provide system-wide vehicle-mile savings up to 37% compared to a traditional delivery system with dedicated vehicles.
content: Crowdsourced delivery를 이미 이루어지고 있는 이동의 여유 capacity를 활용하여 배송하는 개념으로 정의하고, 이를 dynamic pickup and delivery problem with ad hoc drivers로 모델링한 논문이다. 플랫폼은 배송 task와 ad hoc driver를 자동으로 matching하며, ad hoc driver가 처리하지 못하는 task는 플랫폼이 보유한 dedicated vehicle fleet이 담당한다. 새로운 정보가 들어올 때마다 matching 문제를 푸는 rolling horizon framework를 사용하였고 각 시점의 matching 문제는 exact solution approach로 풀었다. ad hoc driver의 행동에 대한 여러 가정 아래 computational experiment를 수행하였으며, ad hoc driver를 활용하면 last mile을 더 cost-efficient하게 운영할 수 있고 dedicated vehicle만 쓰는 기존 방식 대비 vehicle-mile을 최대 37%까지 줄일 수 있다는 결과를 얻었다.
memo: 결과가 ad hoc driver의 행동 가정(수락 여부, detour 허용 범위 등)에 크게 좌우될 것 같다. 37% 절감은 낙관적인 시나리오에서 나온 상한에 가까운 수치로 보이고, 실제 플랫폼 데이터로 확인한 수치인지는 의문이다…

author: 박지호
title: Energy use and life cycle greenhouse gas emissions of drones for commercial package delivery
authors: Joshuah K. Stolaroff; Constantine Samaras; Emma R. O’Neill; Alia Lubers; Alexandra S. Mitchell; Daniel Ceperley
abstract: The use of automated, unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) to deliver commercial packages is poised to become a new industry, significantly shifting energy use in the freight sector. Here we find the current practical range of multi-copters to be about 4 km with current battery technology, requiring a new network of urban warehouses or waystations as support. We show that, although drones consume less energy per package-km than delivery trucks, the additional warehouse energy required and the longer distances traveled by drones per package greatly increase the life-cycle impacts. Still, in most cases examined, the impacts of package delivery by small drone are lower than ground-based delivery. Results suggest that, if carefully deployed, drone-based delivery could reduce greenhouse gas emissions and energy use in the freight sector. To realize the environmental benefits of drone delivery, regulators and firms should focus on minimizing extra warehousing and limiting the size of drones.
content: 상업용 package delivery에 drone을 쓸 때의 energy use와 life cycle greenhouse gas emission을 분석한 논문이다. 현재 battery 기술로 multi-copter의 실용적인 비행 범위는 약 4 km 정도이며, 이를 지원하려면 도시 내 warehouse나 waystation 네트워크가 새로 필요하다고 보았다. Drone은 package-km당 energy 소비는 delivery truck보다 적지만, 추가로 필요한 warehouse energy와 package당 더 길어지는 이동거리 때문에 life-cycle 영향이 크게 늘어난다. 그럼에도 검토한 대부분의 경우에서 small drone 배송의 영향은 ground-based 배송보다 낮았다. 따라서 신중하게 배치한다면 freight 부문의 온실가스와 에너지 사용을 줄일 수 있으며, 이를 위해서는 추가 warehousing을 최소화하고 drone의 크기를 제한해야 한다고 제안한다.
memo: Drone 배송의 환경 효과를 운행 단계만이 아니라 warehouse까지 포함한 life cycle로 본 점이 좋았다. 다만 truck 쪽의 stop density와 적재율을 어떻게 가정하느냐에 따라 결론이 뒤집힐 수도 있을 것 같아 가정을 확인해 볼 필요가 있다.

author: 박지호
title: Reinforcement Learning for Solving the Vehicle Routing Problem
authors: Mohammadreza Nazari; Afshin Oroojlooy; Lawrence V. Snyder; Martin Takáč
abstract: We present an end-to-end framework for solving the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) using reinforcement learning. In this approach, we train a single model that finds near-optimal solutions for problem instances sampled from a given distribution, only by observing the reward signals and following feasibility rules. Our model represents a parameterized stochastic policy, and by applying a policy gradient algorithm to optimize its parameters, the trained model produces the solution as a sequence of consecutive actions in real time, without the need to re-train for every new problem instance. On capacitated VRP, our approach outperforms classical heuristics and Google's OR-Tools on medium-sized instances in solution quality with comparable computation time (after training). We demonstrate how our approach can handle problems with split delivery and explore the effect of such deliveries on the solution quality. Our proposed framework can be applied to other variants of the VRP such as the stochastic VRP, and has the potential to be applied more generally to combinatorial optimization problems.
content: Vehicle Routing Problem(VRP)을 reinforcement learning으로 푸는 end-to-end framework를 제안한 논문이다. 문제 instance가 따르는 분포가 주어지면 reward signal과 feasibility rule만 관측하며 단일 모델을 학습시키고, 모델은 parameterized stochastic policy로서 policy gradient algorithm으로 학습된다. 학습이 끝나면 새로운 instance마다 재학습하지 않고도 연속된 action sequence의 형태로 해를 실시간으로 생성한다. Capacitated VRP의 medium-sized instance에서 classical heuristic과 Google의 OR-Tools보다 비슷한 계산 시간으로 더 좋은 solution quality를 보였고, split delivery가 있는 문제도 다루면서 split delivery가 해의 품질에 미치는 영향을 분석하였다. Stochastic VRP 같은 다른 변형이나 일반적인 combinatorial optimization으로의 확장 가능성도 언급한다.
memo: Medium-sized가 구체적으로 어느 정도 크기인지, 학습 시간까지 포함해도 OR-Tools보다 이득인지가 궁금하다. 시간창이나 이종 차량 같은 제약을 masking만으로 처리할 수 있을지도 의문이다…

author: 박지호
title: Robust Route Planning for Sidewalk Delivery Robots
authors: Xing Tong; Michele D. Simoni
abstract: Sidewalk delivery robots are a promising solution for last-mile freight distribution. Yet, they operate in dynamic environments characterized by pedestrian flows and potential obstacles, which make travel times highly uncertain and can significantly affect their efficiency. This study addresses the robust route planning problem for sidewalk robots by explicitly accounting for travel time uncertainty generated through simulated interactions between robots, pedestrians, and obstacles. Robust optimization is integrated with simulation to reproduce the effect of obstacles and pedestrian flows and generate realistic travel times. Three different approaches to derive uncertainty sets are investigated, including budgeted, ellipsoidal, and support vector clustering (SVC)-based methods, together with a distributionally robust shortest path (DRSP) method based on ambiguity sets that model uncertainty in travel-time distributions. A realistic case study reproducing pedestrian patterns in Stockholm's city center is used to evaluate the efficiency of robust routing across various robot designs and environmental conditions. Results show that, when compared to a conventional shortest path (SP) method, robust routing significantly enhances operational reliability under variable sidewalk conditions. The ellipsoidal and DRSP approaches outperform the other methods in terms of average and worst-case delay. Sensitivity analyses reveal that robust approaches are higher for sidewalk delivery robots that are wider, slower, and more conservative in their navigation behaviors, especially in adverse weather and high pedestrian congestion scenarios.
content: Sidewalk delivery robot의 travel time이 보행자 흐름과 장애물 때문에 불확실하다는 점에 주목하여 robust route planning 문제를 다룬 논문이다. 로봇, 보행자, 장애물 사이의 상호작용을 simulation으로 재현하여 travel time uncertainty를 생성하고, 여기에 robust optimization을 결합하였다. Uncertainty set을 구성하는 방법으로 budgeted, ellipsoidal, support vector clustering(SVC) 기반의 세 가지를 비교하였고, travel time 분포의 ambiguity set에 기반한 distributionally robust shortest path(DRSP) 방법도 함께 검토하였다. Stockholm 도심의 보행 패턴을 재현한 case study에서 기존 shortest path 방법보다 robust routing이 변동이 큰 sidewalk 환경에서 운영 신뢰도를 크게 높였고, 평균 및 worst-case delay 측면에서는 ellipsoidal과 DRSP 방법이 가장 좋았다. 로봇이 크고 느리고 보수적일수록, 날씨가 나쁘고 혼잡할수록 robust 접근의 효과가 컸다.
memo: Case study가 Stockholm 도심 하나이고 travel time도 simulation으로 만든 보행자 흐름에서 나온 것이라, 실제 관측과 얼마나 맞는지가 관건이다. Robust로 갈수록 보수적인 경로를 택할 텐데 평균 소요시간 손해가 얼마인지도 보고 싶다…

author: 박지호
title: A Charging-as-a-Service Platform for Charging Electric Vehicles On the Move: New Vehicle Routing Model and Solution
authors: Jiahua Qiu, Lili Du
abstract: Range anxiety has been the main challenge for the mass-adoption of electric vehicles (EVs). The emerging mobile electric-vehicle-to-electric-vehicle (mE2) charging technology, which allows an EV with the extra battery to charge the other EV on the move, offers a promising solution. Even though the physical feasibility of this new technology has been confirmed, we still face many operation problems. For example, how can we efficiently pair and route an electricity provider (EP) to a demand (ED) without introducing an extra detour? Motivated by this view, this study develops a Charging-as-a-Service (CaaS) platform, which seeks to dispatches the commercial EPs to serve the EDs, for cultivating this emerging charging service towards the low EV penetration environment. Mathematically, the CaaS platform is modeled as a vehicle routing problem (i.e., mE2-VRP), which optimally dispatches the EPs to approach and serve the EDs on the move while minimizing the EP fleet size and fulfilling all service requests. To adapt the CaaS platform to the online application in practice, we develop the Clustering-aided Clarke and Wright Savings (CCWS) algorithm to efficiently decompose and then solve the large-scale mE2-VRP by parallel computing. Our numerical experiments built upon citywide (Chicago) and statewide (Florida) found that the CCWS algorithm outperforms existing commercial solvers, and it enables us to investigate the performance of the CaaS platform under a realistic large-scale setup in a city or state. The CaaS performs better in low EV penetration markets while traffic congestion is mild and EDs require energy earlier. We can improve the performance by developing proper pricing strategies according to the EDs' energy requests and trip lengths.
content: Electric vehicle의 range anxiety를 완화하기 위해, 여분의 battery를 가진 EV가 주행 중인 다른 EV를 충전해 주는 mobile electric-vehicle-to-electric-vehicle(mE2) charging 기술을 서비스로 운영하는 Charging-as-a-Service(CaaS) platform을 제안한 논문이다. 충전을 제공하는 EP를 충전이 필요한 ED에게 detour 없이 pairing하고 경로를 짜는 문제를 mE2-VRP로 모델링하였으며, EP fleet 크기를 최소화하면서 모든 service request를 만족시키는 것이 목적이다. 대규모 문제를 online으로 풀기 위해 Clustering-aided Clarke and Wright Savings(CCWS) algorithm을 개발하여 분해 후 병렬 계산으로 해결하였다. Chicago와 Florida 규모의 실험에서 CCWS가 commercial solver보다 좋은 성능을 보였고, CaaS는 EV 보급률이 낮고 교통 혼잡이 약하며 ED가 에너지를 일찍 요구할수록 더 잘 작동한다는 결과를 얻었다.
memo: 충전소로 가는 대신 충전이 이동해 온다는 발상은 신선하다. 다만 실제로 mE2 충전을 하는 EP를 운영하는 비용과 배터리 가정이 현실적인지 의문이고, pricing 전략은 앞으로 개선할 수 있다는 정도로만 언급되어 아쉽다…

author: 박지호
title: Same-Day Delivery with Drone Resupply
authors: Iman Dayarian; Martin Savelsbergh; John-Paul Clarke
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles, commonly referred to as drones, have recently seen an increased level of interest as their potential use in same-day home delivery has been promoted and advocated by large retailers and courier delivery companies. We introduce a novel way to exploit drones in same-day home delivery settings: drone resupply. We consider a home delivery system in which delivery trucks are regularly resupplied by drones. Resupply can take place whenever a delivery truck is stationary and a drone can land on the truck’s roof. We introduce the vehicle routing problem with drone resupply to capture and investigate this setting. We develop different algorithms and compare their performance. Finally, we quantify the potential benefits of drone resupply and generate valuable insights for advancing this concept.
content: Same-day home delivery에서 drone을 활용하는 새로운 방식인 drone resupply를 제안한 논문이다. 배송 truck이 배송 중에 drone으로부터 물품을 재보급받는 시스템을 가정하며, resupply는 truck이 정차해 있고 drone이 truck 지붕에 착륙할 수 있을 때 이루어질 수 있다. 이 상황을 표현하기 위해 vehicle routing problem with drone resupply를 정의하였고, 여러 알고리즘을 개발하여 성능을 비교하였다. 마지막으로 drone resupply의 잠재적 이점을 정량화하여 이 concept을 발전시키는 데 필요한 insight를 제공한다.
memo: Truck이 정차한 순간에 drone이 지붕에 착륙하는 상황을 전제하는데, 실제 도심에서 truck이 서는 곳과 drone이 안전하게 착륙할 수 있는 조건이 맞아떨어질지는 의문이다. Drone 운영비와 보유 대수가 비용에 어떻게 반영되는지도 확인해야 한다…

author: 박지호
title: Neural Large Neighborhood Search for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
authors: André Hottung; Kevin Tierney
abstract: Learning how to automatically solve optimization problems has the potential to provide the next big leap in optimization technology. The performance of automatically learned heuristics on routing problems has been steadily improving in recent years, but approaches based purely on machine learning are still outperformed by state-of-the-art optimization methods. To close this performance gap, we propose a novel large neighborhood search (LNS) framework for vehicle routing that integrates learned heuristics for generating new solutions. The learning mechanism is based on a deep neural network with an attention mechanism and has been especially designed to be integrated into an LNS search setting. We evaluate our approach on the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) and the split delivery vehicle routing problem (SDVRP). On CVRP instances with up to 297 customers, our approach significantly outperforms an LNS that uses only handcrafted heuristics and a well-known heuristic from the literature. Furthermore, we show for the CVRP and the SDVRP that our approach surpasses the performance of existing machine learning approaches and comes close to the performance of state-of-the-art optimization approaches.
content: Learned heuristic만으로는 routing 문제에서 여전히 state-of-the-art optimization 방법을 이기지 못한다는 한계를 줄이기 위해, 학습된 heuristic을 large neighborhood search(LNS)에 통합한 framework를 제안한 논문이다. 새로운 해를 생성하는 부분을 attention mechanism이 들어간 deep neural network로 구현하였고, 이 구조는 LNS 환경에 맞도록 설계되었다. Capacitated VRP(CVRP)와 split delivery VRP(SDVRP)에서 평가하였으며, 최대 297명의 고객을 가진 CVRP instance에서 hand-crafted heuristic만 쓰는 LNS와 문헌의 잘 알려진 heuristic을 크게 앞섰다. 또한 CVRP와 SDVRP 모두에서 기존 machine learning 방법을 능가하고 state-of-the-art optimization 방법에 근접한 성능을 보였다.
memo: 결국 LNS의 repair 부분을 학습으로 바꾼 구조인데, 최신 optimization solver와의 gap이 어느 정도 남는지와 학습 비용을 감안해도 이득이 있는지가 핵심일 것이다. 297 고객이면 아직 중간 규모라는 점도 아쉽다.

author: 박지호
title: Workforce Scheduling in the Era of Crowdsourced Delivery
authors: Marlin W. Ulmer; Martin Savelsbergh
abstract: Using crowdsourced delivery capacity, that is, individuals offering their vehicle and their time to perform deliveries, can allow companies to provide faster delivery options and more easily accommodate fluctuations in demand. However, because of the uncertainty associated with crowdsourced delivery capacity, ensuring service quality is more challenging. To prevent or mitigate any negative effects of the uncertainty associated with crowdsourced delivery capacity, companies may choose to also have a scheduled delivery workforce that they can control more effectively. We investigate continuous approximation and value function approximation methods for scheduling this workforce, that is, deciding their shifts (start time and duration) to achieve a service level target at minimum cost. An extensive computational study demonstrates the efficacy of our methods and provides insights into the use of crowdsourced delivery capacity.
content: Crowdsourced delivery capacity를 활용하는 기업이 용량의 불확실성 때문에 서비스 품질을 보장하기 어렵다는 문제를 다룬 논문이다. 이를 완화하기 위해 기업이 더 잘 통제할 수 있는 scheduled delivery workforce를 함께 운용하는 상황을 가정하고, 이 workforce의 shift(시작 시간과 지속 시간)를 정하는 문제를 service level target을 최소 비용으로 달성하는 문제로 정식화하였다. 풀이 방법으로 continuous approximation과 value function approximation 두 가지를 검토하였고, 광범위한 computational study로 방법의 효과와 crowdsourced capacity 활용에 대한 insight를 제시하였다.
memo: Crowdsourced 인력의 도착이 불확실하다는 점을 scheduled workforce로 보완하는 구조가 현실적이다. 다만 crowdsourced driver가 시간대별로 얼마나 나타나는지에 대한 확률 가정이 얼마나 현실적인지 궁금하다. 플랫폼 matching 쪽 연구와 연결할 수 있는지 생각해 봐야겠다.

author: 박지호
title: Using Autonomous Modular Vehicle Technology as an Alternative for Last-Mile Delivery
venue: 2024 IEEE Forum on Integrated and Sustainable Transportation System (FISTS)
authors: Amir Shafiee; Hanieh Rastegar Moghaddam; Jane Lin
abstract: With the rise of e-commerce, there is an increasing demand for efficient and timely delivery of goods. The emerging Autonomous Modular Vehicle Technology (AMVT) may provide a promising solution to achieving greater efficiency and agility in last-mile delivery. In this system, vehicles can be coupled together to form a train, optimizing operational costs by creating pods and traversing links as a train. This connection will decrease fuel consumption and also reduce the number of cars in a city, thereby decreasing congestion. These vehicles, or “pods,” will be dispatched to different zones and stations within specific time windows. Upon arrival, customers will be notified to pick up their packages. However, the efficiency of this technology and its benefits for last-mile delivery are not yet clear. The objective of this research is to evaluate the effectiveness and operational cost of the proposed system for package delivery. Additionally, the study aims to explore features that contribute to the cost reduction of this system in comparison to the current scenarios. A mixed-integer programming model is formulated to optimize pod use and determine optimal routes and schedules. Results show that using this system will add some waiting time to the system to allow a pod train to travel. However, it will decrease the overall operation cost of the system compared to classical depot-based methods where trucks deliver packages. Moreover, these cost savings are more significant in areas with higher demand variations and overall demand. Implementing this innovative approach can help delivery companies cut transportation costs while maintaining delivery times and service levels, promoting environmental sustainability to meet the demands of the growing e-commerce industry.
content: Autonomous Modular Vehicle Technology(AMVT)를 last-mile delivery에 적용했을 때의 효과를 평가한 논문이다. AMVT에서는 vehicle(pod)들이 서로 결합하여 train을 이루어 link를 통과하므로 연료 소비와 도시 내 차량 수, 혼잡을 줄일 수 있다. Pod는 특정 time window 안에 여러 zone과 station으로 보내지고, 도착하면 고객에게 알림이 가서 고객이 직접 물건을 가져가는 방식이다. Pod 사용과 경로, 스케줄을 최적화하기 위해 mixed-integer programming 모델을 구성하였다. 결과적으로 pod train이 함께 이동하기 위한 대기시간이 추가되지만, depot에서 truck이 배송하는 기존 방식에 비해 전체 운영비는 줄어들며, 수요의 변동과 총 수요가 클수록 절감 효과가 더 커진다.
memo: Pod train으로 묶어 이동하면 운영비는 줄지만 대기시간이 늘어나는 trade-off가 중심이다. 고객이 station에서 직접 수령하는 구조라 doorstep delivery와는 다르고, 비교 대상이 depot-based truck 하나뿐인 점이 아쉽다. 다음에 modular vehicle 쪽 다른 논문과 같이 볼 것.

author: 박지호
title: U-Aerodrome: Data-driven and risk-bounded airspace reconfiguration for safe integration of urban air mobility at aerodrome
venue: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
authors: Xinting Hu, Bizhao Pang, Sameer Alam, Mir Feroskhan
content: Aerodrome 근처에서 urban air mobility(UAM) 운항을 안전하게 통합하기 위한 airspace reconfiguration 문제를 다룬 논문이다. 관제 aerodrome 주변의 기존 항공 운항과 UAM이 공존해야 하므로, 데이터에 기반하여 공역의 시공간 경계를 재구성하는 U-Aerodrome framework를 제안한다. 이 framework는 확률적이고 risk-bounded한 접근으로 시공간 경계를 최적화하며, Gaussian과 non-Gaussian 데이터 분포를 모두 다루어 안전 보장의 robustness를 확보한다. 공역을 고정된 형태로 두지 않고 상황에 맞게 유연하게 조정한다는 점이 contribution이다.
memo: Risk bound를 어떻게 정하느냐가 실제 aerodrome 운영 기준과 어떻게 연결되는지 궁금하다. 수식과 실험 부분은 다음에 자세히 볼 것.

author: 박지호
title: Towards Autonomous and Safe Last-mile Deliveries with AI-augmented Self-driving Delivery Robots
authors: Eyad Shaklab; Areg Karapetyan; Arjun Sharma; Murad Mebrahtu; Mustofa Basri; Mohamed Nagy; et al.
abstract: In addition to its crucial impact on customer satisfaction, last-mile delivery (LMD) is notorious for being the most time-consuming and costly stage of the shipping process. Pressing environmental concerns combined with the recent surge of e-commerce sales have sparked renewed interest in automation and electrification of last-mile logistics. To address the hurdles faced by existing robotic couriers, this paper introduces a customer-centric and safety-conscious LMD system for small urban communities based on AI-assisted autonomous delivery robots. The presented framework enables end-to-end automation and optimization of the logistic process while catering for real-world imposed operational uncertainties, clients' preferred time schedules, and safety of pedestrians. To this end, the integrated optimization component is modeled as a robust variant of the Cumulative Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows, where routes are constructed under uncertain travel times with an objective to minimize the total latency of deliveries (i.e., the overall waiting time of customers, which can negatively affect their satisfaction). We demonstrate the proposed LMD system's utility through real-world trials in a university campus with a single robotic courier. Implementation aspects as well as the findings and practical insights gained from the deployment are discussed in detail. Lastly, we round up the contributions with numerical simulations to investigate the scalability of the developed mathematical formulation with respect to the number of robotic vehicles and customers.
content: 대학 캠퍼스 같은 small urban community를 대상으로, AI-assisted autonomous delivery robot에 기반한 customer-centric하고 safety-conscious한 last-mile delivery 시스템을 제안한 논문이다. 물류 과정의 end-to-end automation과 optimization을 목표로 하며, 운영상의 불확실성과 고객이 선호하는 시간대, 보행자의 안전을 함께 고려한다. 최적화 부분은 Cumulative Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows의 robust variant로 모델링하였고, travel time이 불확실한 상황에서 전체 배송 latency(고객의 총 대기시간)를 최소화하는 경로를 구성한다. 시스템의 유용성은 university campus에서 로봇 한 대로 수행한 real-world trial로 보였고, 구현 과정에서 얻은 insight를 함께 논의하였다. 마지막으로 로봇과 고객 수에 따른 formulation의 scalability는 numerical simulation으로 확인하였다.
memo: 실제 로봇으로 trial을 했다는 점은 좋지만 한 대뿐이라 fleet 단위의 효과는 결국 simulation에 의존한다. 캠퍼스는 보행자와 도로 구조가 단순해서 일반 도심으로 확장하기에는 거리가 있어 보인다…

author: 박지호
title: POMO: Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima for Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yeong-Dae Kwon; Jinho Choo; Byoungjip Kim; Iljoo Yoon; Youngjune Gwon; Seungjai Min
abstract: In neural combinatorial optimization (CO), reinforcement learning (RL) can turn a deep neural net into a fast, powerful heuristic solver of NP-hard problems. This approach has a great potential in practical applications because it allows near-optimal solutions to be found without expert guides armed with substantial domain knowledge. We introduce Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima (POMO), an end-to-end approach for building such a heuristic solver. POMO is applicable to a wide range of CO problems. It is designed to exploit the symmetries in the representation of a CO solution. POMO uses a modified REINFORCE algorithm that forces diverse rollouts towards all optimal solutions. Empirically, the low-variance baseline of POMO makes RL training fast and stable, and it is more resistant to local minima compared to previous approaches. We also introduce a new augmentation-based inference method, which accompanies POMO nicely. We demonstrate the effectiveness of POMO by solving three popular NP-hard problems, namely, traveling salesman (TSP), capacitated vehicle routing (CVRP), and 0-1 knapsack (KP). For all three, our solver based on POMO shows a significant improvement in performance over all recent learned heuristics. In particular, we achieve the optimality gap of 0.14% with TSP100 while reducing inference time by more than an order of magnitude.
content: Neural combinatorial optimization에서 reinforcement learning으로 NP-hard 문제의 heuristic solver를 만드는 방법인 Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima(POMO)를 제안한 논문이다. CO 문제의 해를 표현할 때 나타나는 symmetry를 활용하도록 설계되었으며, 여러 최적해 모두를 향해 다양한 rollout이 진행되도록 만든 수정된 REINFORCE algorithm을 사용한다. 이 방식의 low-variance baseline 덕분에 RL 학습이 빠르고 안정적이며 local minima에도 더 강하다고 한다. 여기에 augmentation 기반 inference 방법도 새로 제안한다. TSP, CVRP, 0-1 knapsack(KP) 세 가지 문제에서 기존 learned heuristic보다 큰 성능 향상을 보였으며, 특히 TSP100에서 optimality gap 0.14%를 달성하면서 inference time은 한 자릿수 order 이상 줄였다.
memo: 해의 symmetry를 학습에 이용한다는 아이디어가 단순한데 효과가 크다는 점이 인상적이다. 다만 TSP100, CVRP 같은 benchmark 크기에서의 결과라, 실제 도로망 distance matrix나 시간창이 있는 delivery 문제에도 augmentation이 그대로 통하는지는 궁금하다.

author: 박지호
title: Pick-Up and Delivery Problem for Sequentially Consolidated Urban Transportation with Mixed and Multi-Pupropse Vehicle Fleet
authors: Haoye Chen, Jonas Hatzenbühler, Erik Jenelius
abstract: Different urban transportation flows (e.g., passenger journeys, freight distribution, and waste management) are conventionally separately handled by corresponding single-purpose vehicles (SVs). The multi-purpose vehicle (MV) is a novel vehicle concept that can enable the sequential sharing of different transportation flows by changing the so-called modules, thus theoretically improving the efficiency of urban transportation through the utilization of higher vehicles. In this study, a variant of the pick-up and delivery problem with time windows is established to describe the sequential sharing problem considering both MVs and SVs with features of multiple depots, partial recharging strategies, and fleet sizing. MVs can change their load modules to carry all item types that can also be carried by SVs. To solve the routing problem, an adaptive large neighborhood search (ALNS) algorithm is developed with new problem-specific heuristics. The proposed ALNS is tested on 15 small-size cases and evaluated using a commercial MIP solver. Results show that the proposed algorithm is time-efficient and able to generate robust and high-quality solutions. We investigate the performance of the ALNS algorithm by analyzing convergence and selection probabilities of the heuristic solution that destroy and repair operators. On 15 large-size instances, we compare results for pure SV, pure MV, and mixed fleets, showing that the introduction of MVs can allow smaller fleet sizes while approximately keeping the same total travel distance as for pure SVs.
content: Passenger journey, freight distribution, waste management 같은 도시 내 물류와 이동 흐름은 보통 각각의 single-purpose vehicle(SV)이 따로 처리하는데, module을 교체하여 여러 흐름을 순차적으로 공유할 수 있는 multi-purpose vehicle(MV)을 도입했을 때의 효율을 분석한 논문이다. 이를 위해 multiple depot, partial recharging, fleet sizing을 고려한 pick-up and delivery problem with time windows의 변형을 정립하였으며, MV는 load module을 바꾸어 SV가 나를 수 있는 모든 종류의 물품을 운반할 수 있다고 가정한다. 풀이를 위해 문제 특화 heuristic을 넣은 adaptive large neighborhood search(ALNS)를 개발하였고, 15개의 small-size case에서 상용 MIP solver와 비교하여 시간 효율과 해의 품질을 확인하였다. 15개의 large-size instance에서는 pure SV, pure MV, mixed fleet을 비교하여, MV를 도입하면 총 이동거리는 pure SV와 거의 비슷하게 유지하면서 fleet 크기를 줄일 수 있음을 보였다.
memo: ALNS를 MIP solver와 비교한 건 small case뿐이라 large instance에서의 optimality gap은 알 수 없다. 또한 module을 교체하는 데 드는 시간과 비용이 어떻게 반영되는지가 현실적으로 중요한 부분일 것 같다…

author: 박지호
title: Air Traffic Management as a Vital Part of Urban Air Mobility—A Review of DLR’s Research Work from 1995 to 2022
authors: Bianca I. Schuchardt, Dagi Geister, Thomas Lüken, Franz Knabe, Isabel C. Metz, Niklas Peinecke, Karolin Schweiger
abstract: Urban air mobility is a rapidly growing field of research. While drones or unmanned aerial vehicles have been operated mainly in the private and military sector in the past, an increasing range of opportunities is opening up for commercial applications. A new multitude of passenger-carrying drone or air taxi concepts promises to fulfill the dream of flying above congested urban areas. While early research has been focusing on vehicle development, solutions for urban air traffic management are lagging behind. This paper collects and reviews the main findings of past urban-air-mobility-related research projects at the German Aerospace Center (DLR) to serve as a basis for ongoing research from an air traffic management perspective.
content: Urban air mobility(UAM)의 air traffic management 관점에서 독일 항공우주센터(DLR)의 1995년부터 2022년까지의 관련 연구 프로젝트 결과를 정리한 review 논문이다. 초기 연구는 주로 vehicle 개발에 집중하였고 urban air traffic management 해법은 뒤처져 있다는 문제의식에서 출발하며, 과거 DLR의 UAM 관련 연구들의 주요 findings를 모아 향후 연구의 기반으로 제시한다.
memo: DLR 프로젝트를 시기별로 소개하는 성격이라 비판할 부분은 많지 않다. ATM 관점에서 UAM 연구가 어떻게 흘러왔는지 훑어보기에는 좋았다.

author: 박지호
title: Integrated Conflict Management for UAM with Strategic Demand Capacity Balancing and Learning-based Tactical Deconfliction
authors: Shulu Chen; Antony Evans; Marc Brittain; Peng Wei
abstract: Urban air mobility (UAM) has the potential to revolutionize our daily transportation, offering rapid and efficient deliveries of passengers and cargo between dedicated locations within and around the urban environment. Before the commercialization and adoption of this emerging transportation mode, however, aviation safety must be guaranteed, i.e., all the aircraft have to be safely separated by strategic and tactical deconfliction. Reinforcement learning has demonstrated effectiveness in the tactical deconfliction of en route commercial air traffic in simulation. However, its performance is found to be dependent on the traffic density. In this project, we propose a novel framework that combines demand capacity balancing (DCB) for strategic conflict management and reinforcement learning for tactical separation. By using DCB to precondition traffic to proper density levels, we show that reinforcement learning can achieve much better performance for tactical safety separation. Our results also indicate that this DCB preconditioning can allow target levels of safety to be met that are otherwise impossible. In addition, combining strategic DCB with reinforcement learning for tactical separation can meet these safety levels while achieving greater operational efficiency than alternative solutions.
content: UAM에서 항공기들이 strategic deconfliction과 tactical deconfliction을 통해 안전하게 분리되어야 한다는 문제의식에서, strategic conflict management를 위한 demand capacity balancing(DCB)과 tactical separation을 위한 reinforcement learning을 결합한 framework를 제안한 논문이다. 기존 연구에서 RL은 simulation 상의 en route 상업 항공 교통에서 tactical deconfliction에 효과를 보였으나 traffic density에 따라 성능이 달라지는 문제가 있었다. 저자들은 DCB로 교통량을 적절한 밀도 수준으로 미리 조절하면 RL의 tactical safety separation 성능이 훨씬 좋아지고, DCB 없이는 불가능한 목표 안전 수준도 달성할 수 있음을 보였다. 또한 둘을 함께 쓰면 다른 대안들보다 높은 운영 효율을 유지하면서 같은 안전 수준을 만족할 수 있었다.
memo: RL의 tactical 성능이 density에 민감하다는 문제를 strategic 단계에서 density를 조절해 푸는 구조는 납득이 된다. 다만 그만큼 일부 flight를 지연시키거나 거절하게 될 텐데 그 비용이 어떻게 평가되는지 궁금하다. Simulation 환경도 단순하지 않을지…

author: 박지호
title: An optimization framework for urban air mobility (UAM) planning and operations
authors: Heeseung Shon , Jinwoo Lee
abstract: This paper presents an optimized decision-support framework for the planning and operation of Urban Air Mobility (UAM) systems. Alleviating traffic congestion in metropolitan areas has been a persistent challenge for decades, leading to increased interest in aerial mobility solutions. Recent advancements in distributed electric propulsion, battery technology, and autonomous navigation have made electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft a feasible option for intercity transport. For efficient UAM systems, we optimize the high-level planning of UAMs, i.e., determine the numbers of eVTOLs, vertiport spaces, and chargers, together with lower-level operations to control each eVTOL's operational state between in-service, charging, idling, and relocating. Accounting for spatio-temporal demand and cost heterogeneity, we formulate the UAM optimization framework as a mixed-integer programming problem. In our numerical study, we analyze a scenario involving three hypothetical vertiports in the Seoul Metropolitan Area, South Korea. The results reveal relationships between the optimal solution and several exogenous factors critical to eVTOL operations, including the targeted level of service for users and eVTOL charging speed. Additionally, we conduct Monte Carlo simulations to demonstrate the robustness of our solution against stochastic demand and variations in electric consumption.
content: UAM 시스템의 planning과 operation을 위한 optimized decision-support framework를 제안한 논문이다. 상위 수준의 planning으로는 eVTOL 대수, vertiport 공간 수, charger 수를 정하고, 하위 수준의 operation으로는 각 eVTOL의 운영 상태(in-service, charging, idling, relocating)를 제어한다. 시공간적인 수요와 비용의 이질성을 고려하여 mixed-integer programming 문제로 정식화하였다. 수치 실험은 서울 수도권의 가상 vertiport 3개를 가정한 시나리오로 수행하였고, 목표 서비스 수준과 eVTOL 충전 속도 같은 외생 요인과 최적해 사이의 관계를 분석하였다. 또한 Monte Carlo simulation으로 stochastic demand와 전력 소비 변동에 대해 해가 robust함을 보였다.
memo: Vertiport 3개의 가상 시나리오라 실제 규모의 network에서도 MIP가 tractable한지는 알 수 없다. 수요도 hypothetical이어서 결과를 해석할 때 주의가 필요하다. 서울 수도권 맥락이라 참고하기는 좋다…

author: 박지호
title: Collaborative Last-Mile Delivery: A Multi-Platform Vehicle Routing Problem With En-route Charging
authors: Sumbal Malik; Majid Khonji; Khaled Elbassioni; Jorge Dias
abstract: The rapid growth of e-commerce and the increasing demand for timely, cost-effective last-mile delivery have increased interest in collaborative logistics. This research introduces a novel collaborative synchronized multi-platform vehicle routing problem with drones and robots (VRP-DR), where a fleet of $\mathcal{M}$ trucks, $\mathcal{N}$ drones and $\mathcal{K}$ robots, cooperatively delivers parcels. Trucks serve as mobile platforms, enabling the launching, retrieving, and en-route charging of drones and robots, thereby addressing critical limitations such as restricted payload capacities, limited range, and battery constraints. The VRP-DR incorporates five realistic features: (1) multi-visit service per trip, (2) multi-trip operations, (3) flexible docking, allowing returns to the same or different trucks (4) cyclic and acyclic operations, enabling return to the same or different nodes; and (5) en-route charging, enabling drones and robots to recharge while being transported on the truck, maximizing operational efficiency by utilizing idle transit time. The VRP-DR is formulated as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to minimize both operational costs and makespan. To overcome the computational challenges of solving large-scale instances, a scalable heuristic algorithm, FINDER (Flexible INtegrated Delivery with Energy Recharge), is developed, to provide efficient, near-optimal solutions. Numerical experiments across various instance sizes evaluate the performance of the MILP and heuristic approaches in terms of solution quality and computation time. The results demonstrate significant time savings of the combined delivery mode over the truck-only mode and substantial cost reductions from enabling multi-visits. The study also provides insights into the effects of en-route charging, docking flexibility, drone count, speed, and payload capacity on system performance.
content: E-commerce 성장으로 last-mile delivery의 협업 물류에 대한 관심이 커진 상황에서, 트럭, drone, robot이 함께 소포를 배송하는 collaborative synchronized multi-platform vehicle routing problem with drones and robots(VRP-DR)를 제안한 논문이다. 트럭은 drone과 robot을 출발시키고 회수하며 이동 중에 충전까지 해 주는 mobile platform 역할을 하여, 적재 용량, 비행 거리, 배터리 제약을 완화한다. 문제는 한 번의 trip에서 여러 곳을 방문하는 multi-visit, multi-trip 운영, 같은 트럭이나 다른 트럭으로의 flexible docking, cyclic/acyclic 운영, en-route charging의 다섯 가지 특징을 포함하며, 운영 비용과 makespan을 최소화하는 MILP로 정식화하였다. 대규모 instance를 풀기 위해 FINDER라는 heuristic도 개발하였다. 수치 실험에서 truck-only 방식 대비 시간이 크게 절약되고, multi-visit을 허용하면 비용이 크게 줄어든다는 결과를 얻었다.
memo: 트럭에 drone과 robot을 모두 싣는 설정은 현실성이 많이 떨어져 보인다. 다섯 가지 특징을 다 넣은 MILP는 작은 instance에서만 풀릴 텐데, FINDER의 optimality gap이 얼마인지가 중요할 것 같다. Truck-only와의 비교 외에 truck-drone 단독 방식과의 비교도 있었으면 한다…

author: 박지호
title: Learning to Delegate for Large-scale Vehicle Routing
authors: Sirui Li; Zhongxia Yan; Cathy Wu
abstract: Vehicle routing problems (VRPs) form a class of combinatorial problems with wide practical applications. While previous heuristic or learning-based works achieve decent solutions on small problem instances of up to 100 cities, their performance deteriorates in large problems. This article presents a novel learning-augmented local search framework to solve large-scale VRP. The method iteratively improves the solution by identifying appropriate subproblems and $\textit{delegating}$ their improvement to a black box subsolver. At each step, we leverage spatial locality to consider only a linear number of subproblems, rather than exponential. We frame subproblem selection as regression and train a Transformer on a generated training set of problem instances. Our method accelerates state-of-the-art VRP solvers by 10x to 100x while achieving competitive solution qualities for VRPs with sizes ranging from 500 to 3000. Learned subproblem selection offers a 1.5x to 2x speedup over heuristic or random selection. Our results generalize to a variety of VRP distributions, variants, and solvers.
content: 기존의 heuristic이나 learning-based 방법은 100개 도시 정도의 작은 VRP에서는 괜찮은 해를 얻지만 문제가 커지면 성능이 떨어진다는 점에서, 대규모 VRP를 위한 learning-augmented local search framework를 제안한 논문이다. 방법은 해를 반복적으로 개선하되, 개선이 필요한 subproblem을 찾아 그 개선을 black box subsolver에게 delegate하는 방식이다. 매 단계에서 spatial locality를 이용해 지수적인 수가 아니라 선형 수의 subproblem만 고려하며, subproblem 선택을 regression으로 정식화하여 생성한 학습 데이터로 Transformer를 학습시킨다. 500에서 3000 크기의 VRP에서 state-of-the-art solver를 10배에서 100배 가속하면서 경쟁력 있는 해의 품질을 얻었고, 학습된 subproblem 선택은 heuristic이나 random 선택보다 1.5배에서 2배 빠른 속도를 보였다. 다양한 VRP 분포, 변형, solver에도 일반화된다고 한다.
memo: Subsolver를 black box로 두기 때문에 성능의 상당 부분은 subsolver에 의존하고 학습은 subproblem 선택만 돕는 구조이다. Random 선택 대비 1.5~2배 속도 향상이 데이터 생성과 학습 비용을 정당화할 만한지는 의문이다. 대규모 instance 쪽으로 접근한 점은 마음에 든다…

author: 박지호
title: Crowdshipping and Same-day Delivery: Employing In-store Customers to Deliver Online Orders
authors: Iman Dayarian; Martin Savelsbergh
abstract: Same-day delivery of online orders is becoming an indispensable service for large retailers. We explore an environment in which in-store customers supplement company drivers and deliver online orders on their way home. We consider a highly dynamic and stochastic same-day delivery environment in which online orders as well as in-store customers willing to make deliveries arrive throughout the day. Studying settings in which delivery capacity is uncertain is novel and practically relevant. Our proposed approaches are simple, yet produce high-quality solutions in a short amount of time that can be employed in practice. We develop two rolling horizon dispatching approaches: a myopic one that considers only the state of the system when making decisions, and one that also incorporates probabilistic information about future online order and in-store customer arrivals. We quantify the potential benefits of a novel form of crowdshipping for same-day delivery and demonstrate the value of exploiting probabilistic information about the future. We explore the advantages and disadvantages of this form of crowdshipping and show the impact of changes in environment characteristics, for example, online order arrival pattern, company fleet size, and in-store customer compensation on its performance, that is, service quality and operational cost.
content: 온라인 주문의 same-day delivery에서 매장 내 고객(in-store customer)이 회사 소속 driver를 보조하여 귀가하는 길에 온라인 주문을 배달하는 crowdshipping 방식을 연구한 논문이다. 온라인 주문과 배달을 자원하는 매장 고객이 하루 동안 계속 도착하는 매우 동적이고 확률적인 환경을 가정하며, 배송 capacity 자체가 불확실한 설정을 다룬다는 점에서 새롭다고 한다. 두 가지 rolling horizon dispatching 방법을 개발하였는데, 하나는 현재 시스템 상태만 보는 myopic 방식이고 다른 하나는 온라인 주문과 매장 고객의 미래 도착에 대한 확률 정보를 반영하는 방식이다. 이 형태의 crowdshipping이 가져오는 이점을 정량화하고 미래 확률 정보를 활용하는 것의 가치를 보였으며, 주문 도착 패턴, 회사 fleet 크기, 매장 고객 보상 수준 등의 변화가 서비스 품질과 운영 비용에 미치는 영향을 분석하였다.
memo: 매장 고객이 귀가하는 길에 배달한다는 설정은 도착 시점과 경로를 어느 정도 예측할 수 있다는 가정이 필요한데, 실제로 얼마나 많은 고객이 수락하고 약속을 지킬지가 핵심일 것이다. 보상 수준을 고정하지 않고 pricing과 같이 보면 더 현실적일 듯하다…

author: 박지호
title: One-Shot Strategically Deconflicted Route and Operational Volume Generation for Urban Air Mobility Operations
authors: Ellis L Thompson; Yan Xu; Peng Wei
abstract: In the UAM space, strategic deconfliction provides an all-essential layer to airspace automation by providing safe, pre-emptive deconfliction or assignment of airspace resources to airspace users pre-flight. Strategic deconfliction approaches provide an elegant solution to pre-flight deconfliction operations. This overall creates safer and more efficient airspace and reduces the workload on controllers. In this research, we propose a method that constructs routes between start and end nodes in airspace, assigns a contract of operational volumes (OVs) and ensures that these OVs are sufficiently deconflicted against static no-fly zones and OVs of other airspace users. Our approach uses the A* optimal cost path algorithm to generate the shortest routes between the origin and destination. We present a method for generating OVs based on the distribution of aircraft positions from simulated flights; volumes are constructed such that this distribution is conservatively described.
content: UAM 공역에서 strategic deconfliction이 비행 전에 공역 자원을 사용자에게 안전하게 선제적으로 할당하는 핵심 계층이라는 점에서, 출발지와 도착지 사이의 경로를 만들고 operational volume(OV)을 할당하는 방법을 제안한 논문이다. 생성된 OV가 static no-fly zone과 다른 공역 사용자의 OV와 충분히 deconflict되도록 보장한다. 경로는 A* 최적 비용 경로 알고리즘으로 출발지와 도착지 사이의 최단 경로로 생성하고, OV는 simulated flight에서 얻은 항공기 위치 분포를 보수적으로 설명하도록 구성하는 방식으로 만든다.
memo: 결국 A*로 최단경로를 먼저 만든 뒤 OV를 얹는 구조라 비교적 단순한 방법으로 보인다. 항공기 수가 늘어났을 때 OV 사이의 deconfliction이 어떻게 확장되는지가 의문이다.

author: 박지호
title: Near time-optimal trajectory optimisation for drones in last-mile delivery using spatial reformulation approach
venue: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
authors: Y.Y. Chan, Kam K.H. Ng, Tianqi Wang, K.K. Hon, Chun-Ho Liu
content: Drone을 last-mile delivery에 사용할 때의 trajectory를 시간 기준으로 거의 최적에 가깝게 만드는 문제를 다룬 논문이다. 시간이 아닌 공간을 기준으로 문제를 다시 표현하는 spatial reformulation approach를 사용하여 near time-optimal한 trajectory를 구한다. 배송 drone의 비행 시간을 줄이는 방향이라 효율적인 배송 운영에 도움이 될 것으로 보인다.
memo: Trajectory optimization 쪽은 수식 전개를 자세히 보지 못했다. 실제 도시 환경의 바람이나 장애물이 얼마나 반영되었는지 다음에 실험 부분을 확인할 것.

author: 박지호
title: Heterogeneous Attentions for Solving Pickup and Delivery Problem via Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jingwen Li; Liang Xin; Zhiguang Cao; Andrew Lim; Wen Song; Jie Zhang
abstract: Recently, there is an emerging trend to apply deep reinforcement learning to solve the vehicle routing problem (VRP), where a learnt policy governs the selection of next node for visiting. However, existing methods could not handle well the pairing and precedence relationships in the pickup and delivery problem (PDP), which is a representative variant of VRP. To address this challenging issue, we leverage a novel neural network integrated with a heterogeneous attention mechanism to empower the policy in deep reinforcement learning to automatically select the nodes. In particular, the heterogeneous attention mechanism specifically prescribes attentions for each role of the nodes while taking into account the precedence constraint, i.e., the pickup node must precede the pairing delivery node. Further integrated with a masking scheme, the learnt policy is expected to find higher-quality solutions for solving PDP. Extensive experimental results show that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art heuristic and deep learning model, respectively, and generalizes well to different distributions and problem sizes.
content: Deep reinforcement learning으로 VRP를 푸는 기존 방법들이 pickup and delivery problem(PDP)의 pairing과 precedence 관계를 잘 다루지 못한다는 문제를 해결한 논문이다. 정책이 다음에 방문할 node를 고르도록 하는 neural network에 heterogeneous attention mechanism을 넣었으며, 이 attention은 node의 역할(pickup 또는 delivery)마다 별도의 attention을 부여하면서 pickup node가 짝이 되는 delivery node보다 먼저 와야 한다는 precedence constraint를 고려한다. 여기에 masking scheme을 결합하여 학습된 정책이 더 좋은 해를 찾도록 하였다. 광범위한 실험에서 최신 heuristic과 기존 deep learning 모델을 각각 능가하였고, 서로 다른 분포와 문제 크기에도 잘 일반화된다고 보고한다.
memo: Pickup이 delivery보다 먼저 와야 하는 precedence를 attention과 masking으로 처리한 것은 자연스럽다. 다만 실제로 쓰는 강한 heuristic과의 비교가 얼마나 공정했는지, 시간창이나 용량 제약이 붙을 때는 어떻게 되는지가 궁금하다.

author: 박지호
title: An End-to-End Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Solving the Traveling Salesman Problem with Drones
authors: Taihelong Zeng; Yun Lin; Yuhe Shi; Yan Li; Zhiqing Wei; Xuanru Ji
abstract: The emergence of truck-drone collaborative systems in last-mile logistics has positioned the Traveling Salesman Problem with Drones (TSP-D) as a pivotal extension of classical routing optimization, where synchronized vehicle coordination promises substantial operational efficiency and reduced environmental impact, yet introduces NP-hard combinatorial complexity beyond the reach of conventional optimization paradigms. Deep reinforcement learning offers a theoretically grounded framework to address TSP-D's inherent challenges through self-supervised policy learning and adaptive decision-making. This study proposes a hierarchical Actor-Critic deep reinforcement learning framework for solving the TSP-D problem. The architecture consists of two primary components: a Transformer-inspired encoder and an efficient Minimal Gated Unit decoder. The encoder incorporates a novel, optimized k-nearest neighbors sparse attention mechanism specifically for focusing on relevant spatial relationships, further enhanced by the integration of global node features. The Minimal Gated Unit decoder processes these encoded representations to efficiently generate solution sequences. The entire framework operates within an asynchronous advantage actor-critic paradigm. Experimental results show that, on benchmark TSP-D instances of various scales (N=10 to 100), the proposed model can obtain competitive or even superior solutions in shorter average computation times compared to high-performance heuristic algorithms and existing reinforcement learning methods. Moreover, compared to advanced reinforcement learning algorithm benchmarks, the proposed framework significantly reduces the total training time required while achieving superior final performance, highlighting its notable advantage in training efficiency.
content: Truck-drone 협업 시스템에서의 Traveling Salesman Problem with Drones(TSP-D)를 deep reinforcement learning으로 푸는 hierarchical Actor-Critic framework를 제안한 논문이다. 구조는 Transformer에서 영감을 받은 encoder와 효율적인 Minimal Gated Unit decoder의 두 부분으로 이루어진다. Encoder에는 관련 있는 공간적 관계에 집중하기 위해 최적화한 k-nearest neighbors sparse attention mechanism과 global node feature를 넣었고, decoder는 인코딩된 표현으로부터 해 sequence를 생성한다. 전체는 asynchronous advantage actor-critic 방식으로 학습된다. N=10에서 100까지 다양한 규모의 benchmark TSP-D instance에서 고성능 heuristic과 기존 RL 방법에 비해 더 짧은 평균 계산 시간으로 경쟁력 있거나 더 나은 해를 얻었고, 다른 RL 알고리즘에 비해 학습 시간도 크게 줄이면서 최종 성능도 더 좋았다.
memo: N=100까지의 benchmark라 실제 배송 규모에서는 여전히 toy instance 수준이라고 생각한다. 학습 시간 단축을 강조하는데 drone 배터리나 날씨 같은 현실 제약은 들어가 있지 않은 것 같다…

author: 박지호
title: Joint Matching and Pricing for Crowd-shipping with In-store Customers
authors: Arash Dehghan; Mucahit Cevik; Merve Bodur; Bissan Ghaddar
abstract: This paper examines the use of in-store customers as delivery couriers in a centralized crowd-shipping system, targeting the growing need for efficient last-mile delivery in urban areas. We consider a brick-and-mortar retail setting where shoppers are offered compensation to deliver time-sensitive online orders. To manage this process, we propose a Markov Decision Process (MDP) model that captures key uncertainties, including the stochastic arrival of orders and crowd-shippers, and the probabilistic acceptance of delivery offers. Our solution approach integrates Neural Approximate Dynamic Programming (NeurADP) for adaptive order-to-shopper assignment with a Deep Double Q-Network (DDQN) for dynamic pricing. This joint optimization strategy enables multi-drop routing and accounts for offer acceptance uncertainty, aligning more closely with real-world operations. Experimental results demonstrate that the integrated NeurADP + DDQN policy achieves notable improvements in delivery cost efficiency, with up to 6.7\% savings over NeurADP with fixed pricing and approximately 18\% over myopic baselines. We also show that allowing flexible delivery delays and enabling multi-destination routing further reduces operational costs by 8\% and 17\%, respectively. These findings underscore the advantages of dynamic, forward-looking policies in crowd-shipping systems and offer practical guidance for urban logistics operators.
content: Brick-and-mortar 소매점에서 매장 내 고객에게 보상을 주고 시간에 민감한 온라인 주문을 배달시키는 centralized crowd-shipping 시스템을 다룬 논문이다. 주문과 crowd-shipper의 확률적 도착, 배달 제안에 대한 확률적 수락 등 핵심 불확실성을 담은 Markov Decision Process(MDP)로 문제를 모델링하였다. 해법은 주문을 shopper에게 적응적으로 배정하는 Neural Approximate Dynamic Programming(NeurADP)과 동적 가격 결정을 위한 Deep Double Q-Network(DDQN)를 결합한 것으로, 이 joint optimization으로 multi-drop routing과 offer 수락의 불확실성을 함께 다룬다. 실험에서 NeurADP + DDQN 정책이 고정 가격의 NeurADP 대비 최대 6.7%, myopic 정책 대비 약 18%의 비용 절감을 보였고, 배달 지연을 유연하게 허용하고 multi-destination routing을 가능하게 하면 운영 비용이 각각 8%, 17% 추가로 줄어들었다.
memo: NeurADP와 DDQN을 합쳐 pricing까지 같이 학습한 점은 흥미롭다. 다만 고정 가격 NeurADP 대비 절감은 6.7%에 그쳐서, 수락 확률 모형이 달라지면 결과가 어떻게 되는지 궁금하다. 이 수락 모형이 실제 데이터에 기반한 것인지가 중요하다…

author: 박지호
title: Learning Improvement Heuristics for Solving Routing Problems
authors: Yaoxin Wu; Wen Song; Zhiguang Cao; Jie Zhang; Andrew Lim
abstract: Recent studies in using deep learning to solve routing problems focus on construction heuristics, the solutions of which are still far from optimality. Improvement heuristics have great potential to narrow this gap by iteratively refining a solution. However, classic improvement heuristics are all guided by hand-crafted rules which may limit their performance. In this paper, we propose a deep reinforcement learning framework to learn the improvement heuristics for routing problems. We design a self-attention based deep architecture as the policy network to guide the selection of next solution. We apply our method to two important routing problems, i.e. travelling salesman problem (TSP) and capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP). Experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art deep learning based approaches. The learned policies are more effective than the traditional hand-crafted ones, and can be further enhanced by simple diversifying strategies. Moreover, the policies generalize well to different problem sizes, initial solutions and even real-world dataset.
content: Routing 문제에 deep learning을 적용한 기존 연구가 construction heuristic에 집중하여 해가 최적과 멀다는 점에서, improvement heuristic 자체를 deep reinforcement learning으로 학습하는 framework를 제안한 논문이다. 기존 improvement heuristic은 손으로 만든 rule로 움직이기 때문에 성능에 한계가 있다고 보았다. 다음 해를 선택하도록 안내하는 policy network로 self-attention 기반 deep architecture를 설계하였고, TSP와 capacitated VRP(CVRP)에 적용하였다. 실험 결과 최신 deep learning 기반 방법보다 좋은 성능을 보였으며, 학습된 policy가 전통적인 hand-crafted policy보다 효과적이고 간단한 diversifying strategy로 더 향상시킬 수 있었다. 또한 서로 다른 문제 크기, 초기 해, 실제 데이터셋에도 잘 일반화된다.
memo: Construction 방식보다 improvement 방식이 성능이 좋은 것은 납득이 가지만, 반복 step을 계속 돌려야 하므로 inference time이 어떻게 되는지 궁금하다. TSP, CVRP 외에 시간창이나 PDP로 확장하려면 move 정의를 다시 해야 할 것 같다.

author: 박지호
title: GLOP: Learning Global Partition and Local Construction for Solving Large-scale Routing Problems in Real-time
authors: Haoran Ye; Jiarui Wang; Helan Liang; Zhiguang Cao; Yong Li; Fanzhang Li
abstract: The recent end-to-end neural solvers have shown promise for small-scale routing problems but suffered from limited real-time scaling-up performance. This paper proposes GLOP (Global and Local Optimization Policies), a unified hierarchical framework that efficiently scales toward large-scale routing problems. GLOP partitions large routing problems into Travelling Salesman Problems (TSPs) and TSPs into Shortest Hamiltonian Path Problems. For the first time, we hybridize non-autoregressive neural heuristics for coarse-grained problem partitions and autoregressive neural heuristics for fine-grained route constructions, leveraging the scalability of the former and the meticulousness of the latter. Experimental results show that GLOP achieves competitive and state-of-the-art real-time performance on large-scale routing problems, including TSP, ATSP, CVRP, and PCTSP.
content: End-to-end neural solver가 작은 규모의 routing 문제에서는 유망하지만 real-time으로 대규모 문제까지 확장하기에는 한계가 있다는 점에서, 대규모 routing 문제로 효율적으로 scale하는 hierarchical framework인 GLOP(Global and Local Optimization Policies)를 제안한 논문이다. GLOP은 큰 routing 문제를 여러 TSP로, TSP를 다시 Shortest Hamiltonian Path Problem으로 분할한다. 거친 단위의 문제 분할에는 non-autoregressive neural heuristic을, 세밀한 단위의 경로 구성에는 autoregressive neural heuristic을 쓰는 hybrid 구조이며, 앞의 scalability와 뒤의 정밀함을 함께 활용한다는 점이 저자들이 내세우는 첫 시도이다. TSP, ATSP, CVRP, PCTSP를 포함한 대규모 routing 문제에서 경쟁력 있는 state-of-the-art real-time 성능을 보였다.
memo: VRP를 TSP로, TSP를 Shortest Hamiltonian Path로 쪼개는 hierarchical 구조가 실용적으로 보인다. 다만 partition 품질이 낮으면 이후 local construction이 만회하기 어려울 것 같고, 시간창이 있는 문제에서도 통하는지가 관건이다…
